market_source: FantasyPros 2026 PPR consensus ADP / current player ADP pages, checked Sep 3 2026
label_rule: BUY when model target is materially earlier than PPR market cost; FAIR when gap is small or risk balances the gap; REACH when market cost is materially earlier than model target; FADE when market is substantially too aggressive relative to active injury/availability/role risk.

connected_qa.reason: Puka risk adjustment and Corum development can coexist. Corum's rise increases contingent/standalone value but does not assert that Kyren lost the lead role.
BTJ and Parker gains are chemistry/development/role-confidence gains rather than mutually exclusive WR1 claims; both improve Lawrence's receiving environment.
Mahomes recovery improves the passing environment. Rice rises from risk removal; no forced Worthy downgrade because the signal is QB health/efficiency rather than a new target-share loss.
Jacobs availability loss directly supports Lloyd opportunity. Jonnu's separate role downgrade is consistent with Tucker Kraft remaining ahead.
Kamara and Tyson availability losses correctly redistribute opportunity toward Etienne and Olave; Shough starter confirmation is independent QB role value.
Love's ankle risk raises Allgeier contingency value; Harrison's receiving-role improvement is independent of the RB injury.
Pacheco IR raises Gibbs workload while LaPorta's separate hip/back availability risk remains negative.
Jones health/starter certainty supports the Colts passing environment while Downs and Pierce role-security evidence can both improve without a zero-sum contradiction.
Washington gains contingency value from Jeanty's ankle watch while Jeanty's season-long ceiling remains intact; no double downgrade to Jeanty.
